snippet.title: Hot Pot Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Hot Pot Game is a new generation of drop and merge puzzle game.
You drop and merge cute-looking ingredients to aim for a high score, but each time you combine, you gain experience points, and as you level up, you can choose an item from a random selection.
The effects of the items are diverse, with over 50 different types, ranging from those that shake the ingredients or pot to those that change gravity, and even those that allow you to change the order of merging.
Since you can earn experience point bonuses by merge streaks, you may need to consider strategies such as putting off merging and arranging the board.
There are also game modes where obstacles spawn over time, and game modes where abnormal events such as volcanic eruptions and board tilts periodically occur, allowing for a diverse gaming experience.
